profile.headline: AWS-certified full stack web developer by day, building Web3 apps on Cardano by night.
profile.summary: I am full stack developer by day and web development instructor by night.

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
Developed and made changes to company’s existing sites and applications.
Applications technologies include WordPress, React, SCSS, Docker, SQL and Javascript.

positions.title: Web Development Instructor
positions.description: Helping adult learners transition/start careers in web development by teaching popular technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, React, NodeJS, and MongoDB.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and maintain web-based enterprise applications which integrate data from various back-end services and databases.

Work with team members to improve enterprise application solutions.

Create documentation for end-users.

Test changes and solution in development environments prior to releasing updates to production.

Write well-designed, testable, efficient code using the best software development practices
Participate in analyzing, designing, developing, testing, and implementing application enhancements

positions.title: Guitar Inspector
positions.locationName: San Bernardino County, California, United States
positions.description: Tune test guitar for playability and intonation. Assure all component parts are installed correctly and meet finish criteria. Make necessary adjustments to component parts-bridge/saddle, nut, neck, and pickups, etc. Hand feel product and visually inspect product for any damage scratches that don t pass criteria. Wipe product with cloth and buff/polish guitars that need a smooth shine finish.

positions.title: CITES Administrator for Fender Musical Instruments
positions.description:
Using VBA, I Implemented macros that automated various/repetitive tasks,
saving the company money and time. 

Furthermore, I successfully coordinated with international government agencies to ensure the safe arrival of Fender Products.

I used RedPraire to inquire about staged/picked product. I then extracted the data into an excel sheet and implemented pivot tables and other excel formulas to extract or convert all necessary data. 

Maintained Access database for all customer shipping addresses.  

Created a mock-up F.A.Q page for the CITES portal using Javascript, JQuery, HTML5. and CSS.

positions.title: Software Development Tutor
positions.description:
Lead one-on-one sessions with students over a one hour long video conference each week.

Monitored student concerns and inquiries regarding the course curriculum and the learning process.

Lead and collaborate with instructional team members to best meet students need.

positions.title: Substitute Instructor
positions.description:
I lead class sessions by lecturing, coaching, and facilitating student learning.

The subject matter taught involves HTML/CSS/JavaScript, jQuery, Git, deployment across static and dynamic sites, Node, Express, React, Firebase, MongoDB, MySQL, and computer science fundamentals.

positions.title: University of California Berkeley Web Development Extension Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Walked around class during code activities and projects assisted students with popular web development technologies such as JavaScipt, CSS, HTML5, Git, Node.js and others. 

Furthermore, I helped in researching and answering student questions when the instructor was preoccupied.

positions.title: Part-Time Substitute Teaching Assistant for University of California RIverside
positions.description: As a substitute teaching assistant, I helped students strengthen their web development skills by teaching them core concepts such as the box model, GoogleFu skills, differences between classes and ID's in CSS, and the differences between MySQL "join" tables.

positions.title: Aerospace Inspector
positions.description:
Developed and set up the calibration department. I was also responsible for creating the standard operating procedures for the calibration department. 

I participated in Gemba walks and provided recommendations to my supervisor if any improvements could be made. 
 
Responsible for maintaining accurate records both physically and in google drive.

positions.title: Aerospace Inspector
positions.description:
Used math and critical thinking skills to conclude dimensions of complex machined aerospace equipment. 

I participated kaizen procedures to improve the day to day operations of manufacturing procedures. 

Directed machinist on issues pertaining to quality requirements provided by the customer.

positions.title: Parks and Recreation Leader
positions.description: As a recreational leader, I was responsible for promoting programs such as Summer Work Experience Program and the summer after school program. I was also in charge of keeping accurate records of sensitive information and planning community events. In addition, I was in charge of organizing, leading, and supervising daily playground activities for children ranging in the ages of 6  to 12 years old.

positions.title: Program Leader
positions.description:
As a substitute program leader I was responsible for creating a fun and safe educational environment.
 
Furthermore, I was also responsible for helping students deconstruct challenging math problems by creating visualizations thus helping them arrive the correct answer.  

I strived daily to help student reach their potential by helping them complete their homework and having one on one motivational discussions.

positions.title: Periodical Assistant
positions.description:
I was a Participant in Riversides Summer Work Experience program. I took inventory of books and helped
customers with any requests. Also, I cleaned the book shelves and books. Organizing the books in order was
also a part of the daily schedule.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
Cashier and washed dishes. Occasionally I would serve the customers food. Other duties included handing out
ﬂyer's to promote their specials. I departed from the restaurant due to low sells causing layoffs.

courses.name: Javascript Algorithms and Data Structures Masterclass

honors.title: Perfect Student rating as web development Insrtuctor
honors.description: I received a perfect 5 out 5 score from students who were in my Bootstrap web development class.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered at the Riverside Public library. My hour of volunteer experience mostly consisted of clerical work such as filing and shelving books.

projects.title: Drum Machine
projects.description: This project was created on CodePen.com. It is a drum machine that uses the React.js framework to build its individual components.

projects.title: Fake Udemy Complaint Form
projects.description:
Used SCSS to create a fake complaint form for Udemy.com.
I took the tutorials offered in FreeCodeCamp.com to accomplish the design.
